text:
incident-bot: Pager: SEV-2 metering telemetry — token counts diverging from primary ledger, multiple customer overage flags triggered. Autogenerated alert: https://internal.incidents/redwood/5967890123. Paging @oncall-maria and infra-oncall.
oncall-maria: I’m on it, joining now. can someone grab a quick blast radius?
samir: quick snapshot: emit pipeline shows delayed flush + duplication window from 00:30–00:42 UTC on emitter-shard-7. replays look suspicious. running a quick q now.```sql
-- rough query run on telemetry cluster
select shard, count(*) as emits, avg(tokens) from token_emits
where ts >= '2026-03-17T00:00:00Z' and ts < '2026-03-17T01:00:00Z'
group by shard;
-- shard-7 emits ~42% higher than baseline
```
ryan: are billing/overage flags live? any customer charges already processed?
billing-bot: Auto-flagging pipeline triggered for 128 accounts between 00:34–00:40 UTC. Billing writebacks to charge queue are queued; no finalized invoices yet. Suppression not active.
emma: oncall-maria — I can flip suppression to dry-run in 2 mins. recommend suppressing new overage flags for 15m while we triage.
oncall-maria: do it. emma, please. also escalate to cs for any customers who got alerts.
emma: running playbook:```bash
/runplaybook suppress-overage --mode dry-run --duration 15m --reason "emit-duplication-shard7"
```
emma: suppression command accepted — dry-run enabled. will convert to full-suppress after we confirm duplication.
samir: preliminary root cause: emitter ack handler retried acks after transient Redis timeout; some messages re-emitted without dedupe key due to a race. investigating rollback vs hotfix.
ben: can we flip emitter to idempotent dedupe quickly? or rollback the last deploy to emitter service (deploy abc123 -> previous commit def456)?
oncall-maria: what’s the blast radius if we rollback? shard7 only or all shards?
samir: safe rollback to def456 on emitter-shard-7 only should remove the duplicate behavior for new emits. backfill still needed for duplicates already emitted.
oncall-maria: do it. ben, coordinate rollback on shard-7 and restart emitter workers. tag me.
ben: starting targeted rollback on shard-7 to def456 -> rolling restart feed. logs: `rolling-restart emitter-shard-7 commit=def456`. ETA ~3m.
billing-bot: suppression update: dry-run active at 5967890250. 0 new writebacks since suppression start, 42 queued pending reconciliation.
csm-julia: CS: 4 customers received overage notification emails (non-billing alert only). prepping proactive note and FAQ. linking incident thread.
samir: kicked off reconciliation job to identify duplicate emits and mark for backfill correction:```python
# job pseudocode
for event in duplicate_candidates:
    mark_for_backfill(event.id)
```
samir: backfill queued — estimate 30–45m to fully reconcile token deltas for affected accounts.
oncall-maria: monitoring metrics now. shard-7 error rate dropping post-rollback, emit-rate normalizing.
ryan: do we need to refund or credit any customers? billing impact depends on whether charges were finalized. billing team — advise.
billing-bot: No charges finalized. queued charge writebacks held. if reconciliation shows +tokens were duplicates we will cancel queued charges and apply credits as necessary. track with ticket BILL-5967.
csm-julia: CS will pause outbound comms until we have full reconciliation and a recommended statement. will prepare draft.
oncall-maria: status update: rollback completed on shard-7 at 5967890290. suppression remains in place. reconciliation job started at 5967890315.
samir: logs show de-dupe backpressure recovered; emitter ack latency normalized. initial reconciliation pass found ~14k duplicate token emits across 128 accounts.
ben: action items: (1) billing team to hold writebacks and prepare refund flow (billing-BILL-5967) (2) infra to validate emitter dedupe fix in staging and roll to prod (samir, ben) (3) ops to keep suppression until reconciliation done (emma) (4) CS prepare customer comms (csm-julia).
oncall-maria: agree. I'm assigning follow-ups and will stay on for the next hour. will update channel at 5967890380 with final short summary.
incident-bot: Note: incident annotated with tags [metering][billing][pager][live-mitigation] and assigned incident lead oncall-maria.
oncall-maria: final interim: suppression active, rollback success, reconciliation in progress, no finalized charges. estimated time to closure ~45–90m. will escalate if any customers report immediate financial impact. thanks team. :thumbsup:
